summary.text: Mike Van Someren is the Democratic candidate for Wisconsin State Senate District 33 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Republican Chris Kapenga.
An attorney, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that he was a candidate for the U.S. House in Wisconsin's 5th Congressional District in 2022.

paragraphs.text: Mike Van Someren earned a high school diploma from Somerset High School, a bachelor's degree from the University of Wisconsin in 2008 and a law degree from Marquette University Law School in 2012.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he grew up in Somerset, Wisconsin, as the son of a truck driver and a secretary, and that he was a member of the University of Wisconsin-Madison football program.
He said he practices as a transactional attorney at Amundsen Davis, assisting clients with commercial real estate transactions and advising businesses and organizations on governance and compliance.
He advanced from the Democratic primary for Wisconsin State Senate District 33 on August 11, 2026.
Van Someren said his public policy priorities include raising wages, addressing property tax pressures on homeowners, and increasing transparency and accountability in government.
He said he lives in southeastern Wisconsin with his spouse and two daughters.
